page_title: UDI 1-1 LEC | Udinese v Lecce 23/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is on for Hassane Kamara.
90+1' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

86' Martin Payero (Udinese) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
86' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Lazar Samardzic (Udinese), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
84' Paride Tremolada shows a yellow card to Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) for his blatant foul.

83' 1 - 1 Nicola Sansone sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
83' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
82' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
79' Here is a change. Mohamed Kaba is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
78' Martin Payero (Udinese) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paride Tremolada had an easy-decision to make.
77' Substitution. Nikola Krstovic did his best and is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
77' The game has come to an end for Gabriel Strefezza. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
76' Andrea Sottil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Payero (Udinese) replacing Roberto Pereyra.
76' Andrea Sottil has decided to substitute Isaac Success (Udinese) and he is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca.
75' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
73' The referee shows a yellow card to Federico Baschirotto (Lecce). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
72' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
72' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
70' Lameck Banda (Lecce) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
67' Today's match ends for Antonino Gallo who will be replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
67' That will be all from Remi Oudin who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lameck Banda (Lecce).
67' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' Some neat passing and movement from Udinese as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
60' The shots on goal statistics – 5:0.
57' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
55' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post.
55' Lecce earn a corner.
53' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Isaac Success (Udinese) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Wladimiro Falcone to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
48' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is going to take the penalty!

47' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) trips an opposition player and Paride Tremolada signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Udinese after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
47' Isaac Success (Udinese) plants a goal-bound header towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.

46' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Isaac Success (Udinese) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
46' Andrea Sottil makes a switch. Festy Ebosele is coming on in place of Joao Ferreira (Udinese) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Paride Tremolada has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Wladimiro Falcone stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
45+1' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:4.
42' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
41' Good clearance! Isaac Success (Udinese) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
40' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Silvestri (Udinese).
39' The free kick is delivered by Remi Oudin (Lecce) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Paride Tremolada interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jaka Bijol (Udinese). Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

36' That didn't go as planned! Isaac Success (Udinese) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Wladimiro Falcone, who easily kept it out.
35' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
34' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
31' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
30' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Antonino Gallo (Lecce).

27' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
26' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Udinese.
25' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.

22' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

21' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
20' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone was alert and made a comfortable save.
19' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. It's a free kick to Udinese in a dangerous position.
17' Paride Tremolada has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nehuen Perez (Udinese). Lecce earn a free kick.
15' The possession of the ball – 42:58.
14' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
13' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' So close! Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
11' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' Remi Oudin (Lecce) will take the corner.

6' Remi Oudin (Lecce) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' The free kick is taken by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce), but ball is cleared.
5' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Paride Tremolada and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
4' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
2' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
2' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
1' Remi Oudin (Lecce) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Paride Tremolada.
